title: Trace non-interference
contract: For equal public input, executions differing only in secret must expose identical public output AND public step count.
scope: Public and secret bits, explicit abstract observation (value, steps); no wall-clock claim.
assumptions: Exact finite abstract model in scope; no inference to unbounded behavior, LLMLang correspondence or other semantic profiles.

obligations.claim: For every pair of secrets, observations equal (public,2).

variants.description: Perform one additional observable step for secret=1.
Pad both branches to two steps.
